label: Game B
nuance_found: Enemy types force different answers: knights bounce toothpicks so you need a Cheese Grater, greasers speed up olives behind them, rings are hard to hit so splash and slow (mustard) matter. Stacking three different layers on one tower makes a CLUB (+25% everything), and calling the next wave early pays a crumb bonus and score but risks leaks. I also learned to save crumbs for the grater before knights arrive, since I lost a run with 20 bites gone by wave 5 when I built the wrong mix. Active Swat/Flame/Rinse/Pepper abilities add timing.
audio: Short sample sfx (cannon thwump, pop, place, wave ding) and pitched blips on each action; almost no music, long silent stretches during waves, a quiet triangle-note sequence only now and then.
furthest_progress: Cleared The Cutting Board (3 stars, 14,180), The Stovetop (2 stars, 36,010, beat the Jar boss) and The Sink (3 stars, 25,210) on the second try after losing once; was in Sunday Lunch (level 4) at wave 9 of 12 with 15 of 20 bites left and score 11,700 at 542 s; hub showed 8 of 15 stars.
control_trouble: Several taps landed on the wrong plot or on 2x instead of START because buttons are small and my act timing is blind; once a tap hit nothing during a result screen. A real thumb sees the panel and would not misfire.
best_moment: Stacking three layers on a pickle cannon to make a CLUB mid-wave, then watching a x59 combo rip through the Jar boss wave on the Stovetop.
worst_moment: Losing the first Sink run: knights walked through toothpicks at wave 5 and the score screen showed 1,520 against a best of 22,160, a hard swing for one wrong build.
verdict: This hooked me fast. I knew what to do in ten seconds and then every wave asked a new question: armor, speed, rings, a boss jar. Orders, stars, combos and a best-score line on every result screen gave me something to beat, and calling waves early for bonus is a real risk-reward button. It looks like a finished mobile game. Weak spots are almost no music and some wave stretches where I just watch. I would open this again tomorrow to three-star the Stovetop.
